Set up pseudobulk comparisons from a single-cell dataset

Source: R/pbSetup.R
pbSetup.Rd

Aggregates a single-cell dataset to pseudobulk once per annotation level and returns the object the rest of the package operates on: a named S4Vectors::SimpleList holding one pseudobulk SummarizedExperiment per annotation set. Each pseudobulk is a gene-by-(sample x cluster) matrix with per-pseudobulk metadata in colData, and the comparison definitions, column names and per-cluster cell-level overdispersion (theta) in metadata().

Usage

pbSetup(
  sce,
  sample,
  group,
  annotations,
  covariates = character(0),
  contrasts = NULL,
  pairing = NULL,
  minCells = 10,
  aggregation = c("sum", "mean"),
  assayName = "counts",
  thetaCells = 50,
  thetaDonors = 50,
  thetaReps = 3,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
)

Arguments

sce

A SingleCellExperiment::SingleCellExperiment or SummarizedExperiment with a raw-count assay (non-negative integers).

sample

Character scalar; colData column giving the biological sample (donor) each cell belongs to.

group

Character scalar; colData column giving the condition compared.

annotations

Character vector of colData columns, each a clustering (annotation level) to pseudobulk, e.g. c("cell_type_broad").

covariates

Character vector of colData columns to carry as candidate confounders. Default none.

contrasts

Optional list of length-2 character vectors c(A, B) naming group levels to compare (B vs A). Default NULL: all non-reference levels versus the first level.

pairing

Optional colData column for paired designs (reserved; not used in the MVP).

minCells

Integer; pseudobulks with fewer contributing cells are dropped. Default 10.

aggregation

Either "sum" (counts, for the negative-binomial model) or "mean" (reserved for the limma path). Default "sum".

assayName

Name of the raw-count assay in sce. Default "counts".

thetaCells, thetaDonors, thetaReps

Subsample size (cells per donor, donors) and number of draws for the cell-level theta ensemble. thetaReps = 0 skips the theta fit (by far the slowest step): the adequacy call is unchanged, since the sensitivity uses the total pseudobulk dispersion, but the depth/cell/donor variance decomposition from estimateVariance() is then NA.

BPPARAM

A BiocParallelParam object for the per-cluster theta estimation. Default BiocParallel::SerialParam().

Value

A named S4Vectors::SimpleList of SummarizedExperiment, one per annotation level.

Details

Cell-level theta (within-donor cell-to-cell overdispersion, needed by estimateVariance()) is estimated here, while the cells are in hand, so the later steps never need the single-cell object again.
